- **Kilocode TUI subagent steering (PR #14702) NEW MEDIUM PRIORITY** merged 2026-10-03. When viewing a running subagent in the TUI, the prompt is now available to steer that subagent directly. The steer goes through the normal session prompt queue, and the parent is notified via an `INFO` message on the shared agent board. ## Detailed Findings

#### 1. Kilocode TUI subagent steering - NEW MEDIUM PRIORITY (tui + core)

- **What**: Kilocode PR #14702 "feat(tui): steer running subagents from their view" merged 2026-10-03 (depends on #14701 double Esc interrupt). When viewing a running subagent in the TUI, the prompt is now available to steer that subagent directly instead of going through the parent. The steer sends the child's own agent/model/variant through the normal session prompt queue. The parent agent is notified via an `INFO` message on the shared agent board (`task_id` → `parentID` message with steering text excerpt). The prompt visually indicates subagent steering: replaces primary agent/model row with `Steering <agent> · <model>`, uses subagent's color matching footer, placeholder reads `Steer the <agent> subagent...`. Plain steering prompts only; shell mode (`!`) and slash commands (`/`) disabled (typed as text, command list does not open). Steering marked with `metadata.kind = "subagent_steer"` to distinguish from task tool's own prompts on child sessions. Only running subagents accept input; steer on finished child would start orphaned turn. Keys follow #14701: double Esc stops subagent, parent/sibling navigation (arrows) and double-press exit act on view while prompt unfocused/empty, arrows/ctrl+c/ctrl+d work normally once text typed. Ink TUI with subagent footer.

- **Why**: **Alexi has TUI** (`src/cli/tui/` with Ink + React 19, `src/cli/tui/App.tsx` 14084 bytes, `src/cli/tui/components/` + `hooks/` + `pages/`) and task tool (`src/tool/tools/task.ts`). Subagent views in Alexi TUI are read-only (based on Kilocode pattern pre-#14702). Users cannot redirect a running subagent without going through the parent agent, which is slower and keeps the parent reasoning from an outdated plan. Kilocode pattern: mount prompt in subagent view with visual indicators (steering header, subagent color, distinct placeholder), send steer through session prompt queue with `metadata.kind = "subagent_steer"`, notify parent via board `INFO` message with excerpted text, disable shell/slash commands in subagent views, respect key hierarchy (autocomplete > double-press interrupt/exit > cursor movement). **Alexi already has TUI infrastructure** (Ink + React 19, subagent views in `src/cli/tui/`, board messages in `src/tool/tools/board.ts`, task tool with parent/child sessions) — need to add prompt mounting in subagent view, steering visual treatment, board notification on steer, and key hierarchy in subagent context. MEDIUM PRIORITY ~4-6h (add prompt component to subagent view in `src/cli/tui/pages/` or similar, apply visual treatment: replace primary agent/model row with `Steering <agent>`, use subagent color, distinct placeholder, disable shell mode and slash command parsing for steering text, mark steer with `metadata.kind = "subagent_steer"`, post board `INFO` to parent with excerpted text after prompt admission, implement key hierarchy: double Esc > arrows/exit > cursor movement, add tests for steer submission, board notification, key precedence, verify `npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test` green).

- **Source**: https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/14702 (Kilocode subagent steering, merged 2026-10-03, 5 commits), /home/runner/work/alexi/alexi/src/cli/tui/ (TUI components with Ink + React 19, 10 subdirs), /home/runner/work/alexi/alexi/src/tool/tools/task.ts (task tool), /home/runner/work/alexi/alexi/src/tool/tools/board.ts (board messages)

- **Category**: tui (subagent view prompt mounting, visual treatment, key hierarchy) + core (board notification on steer, metadata marking)

- **Size**: MEDIUM ~4-6h (add prompt component to subagent view in `src/cli/tui/pages/` or `src/cli/tui/components/`, apply visual treatment: replace agent/model header with `Steering <agent> · <model>`, apply subagent color from footer, set placeholder `Steer the <agent> subagent...`, disable shell mode (`!` as text) and slash command parsing (`/` as text, no command list), mark steer with `metadata.kind = "subagent_steer"` in prompt submission, post board `INFO` message to `parentID` with excerpted steering text after prompt admission (after paused/noReply early returns, excerpt against 4 KiB board limit), implement key hierarchy: open autocomplete > double Esc interrupt (#14701) > parent/sibling navigation + exit double-press while unfocused/empty > normal cursor movement when text typed, add unit tests for steer submission with metadata, board notification to parent, key hierarchy precedence, integration test with running subagent, verify `npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test` green, test in running TUI with `alexi chat` + task tool + subagent view + steer prompt)

#### 2. Kilocode subagent interrupt - NEW SMALL PRIORITY (tui)

- **What**: Kilocode PR #14701 "feat(cli): interrupt a subagent from its view with double Esc" merged 2026-10-03. In the TUI's subagent view, double Esc stops the subagent (sends `session.abort` on the subagent with `scope: "tree"`, stops subagent and anything it started, parent not aborted). Footer shows **Interrupt esc** next to Parent/Prev/Next, turns into **Interrupt esc again** after first press, also clickable. Parent finishes in-flight step, gets `Task cancelled by the user` result (not `Task cancelled`). Leaving the TUI needs a second press of the exit key (Ctrl+C by default), restoring confirmation from Kilo #195 lost when #12204 moved TUI into `packages/tui`. Keys follow config: `subagent_interrupt` keybind defaults to `escape`, exit guard uses configured `app_exit` keys. Both bindings off while permission/question/suggestion/network prompt pending. Server change: cancelled task result now gives reason `Task cancelled by the user` (prevents parent from immediately starting replacement subagent).

- **Why**: **Alexi TUI** has subagent views but no way to stop a subagent from its view without interrupting the whole parent turn. A single Ctrl+C in subagent view quits the app (no confirmation). Kilocode pattern: double Esc stops subagent tree via `session.abort({ scope: "tree" })`, footer shows interrupt hint with press count, second press of exit key required to quit app. **Alexi already has TUI infrastructure** (Ink + React 19, `src/cli/tui/App.tsx` + `hooks/` + `components/`) and subagent views — need to add double-press interrupt handler in subagent view, footer hint with press count, exit confirmation, and task result reason propagation. SMALL PRIORITY ~2-3h (add `subagent_interrupt` keybind to config with default `escape`, implement double-press handler in subagent view following `createDoublePress` pattern from Kilocode, send `session.abort({ scope: "tree" })` on second press, show footer hint **Interrupt esc** / **Interrupt esc again** with press count, make hint clickable, disable keybind while permission/question/suggestion/network prompt pending, add exit key double-press confirmation following Kilo #195 pattern using configured `app_exit` keys, update task tool result for cancelled subagent to `Task cancelled by the user`, add tests for double-press interrupt, exit confirmation, result reason, verify `npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test` green).

- **Source**: https://github.com/Kilo-Org/kilocode/pull/14701 (Kilocode subagent interrupt, merged 2026-10-03, 7 commits), /home/runner/work/alexi/alexi/src/cli/tui/App.tsx (TUI main component, 14084 bytes), /home/runner/work/alexi/alexi/src/cli/tui/hooks/ (TUI hooks), /home/runner/work/alexi/alexi/src/tool/tools/task.ts (task tool with parent/child sessions)

- **Category**: tui (subagent interrupt, double-press handler, exit confirmation)

- **Size**: SMALL ~2-3h (add `subagent_interrupt` keybind to config schema in `src/config/` with default `escape`, implement double-press handler in subagent view (`src/cli/tui/hooks/` or `src/cli/tui/pages/`) following `createDoublePress` pattern from Kilocode #14701 (counter, per-press timers, configurable timeout), send `session.abort` with `scope: "tree"` on subagent session on second press, add footer hint **Interrupt esc** turning into **Interrupt esc again** after first press with press count, make hint clickable (same handler), disable keybind while permission/question/suggestion/network prompt pending (check prompt state), add exit key double-press confirmation for app exit (Ctrl+C or configured `app_exit` keys) using same `createDoublePress` helper, update task tool (`src/tool/tools/task.ts`) to report `Task cancelled by the user` instead of `Task cancelled` when subagent aborted, add unit tests for double-press interrupt (first press arms, second press aborts, timeout resets), exit confirmation (single press warned, second press exits), result reason propagation, verify `npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test` green, test in running TUI with subagent view + double Esc + exit double-press)

#### 3. Cline Langfuse BYOK tracing - NEW LOW PRIORITY (providers + telemetry)

- **What**: Cline PR #14787 "feat(llms): opt-in Langfuse tracing for BYOK providers plus env tags, metadata and environment" merged 2026-10-03. Adds `CLINE_LANGFUSE_ALL_PROVIDERS=1` opt-in for third-party provider tracing (OpenRouter, etc.). Previously Langfuse tracing was limited to `cline` and `cline-pass` providers (SDK 0.0.83, CLI 3.0.62+). Operators pointing `LANGFUSE_BASE_URL` / `LANGFUSE_PUBLIC_KEY` / `LANGFUSE_SECRET_KEY` at their own Langfuse instance can now trace BYOK providers. BYOK providers export only through isolated direct exporter (never through host OTLP relay), so BYOK prompts cannot reach a collector the operator did not configure themselves. Also adds `LANGFUSE_TRACING_ENVIRONMENT` (passed to direct exporter, sets Langfuse environment), `CLINE_LANGFUSE_TAGS` (comma-separated trace tags), `CLINE_LANGFUSE_METADATA` (JSON object or `key=value,...` for trace metadata). Env values merge under runtime's own attributes (tags deduped, call-site metadata wins on key conflicts), env-only attributes propagate even when a call supplies none of its own. Benchmark and isolated-environment runs can label traces per environment/suite/commit. Direct exporter only for BYOK (relay bypass). Changes in `sdk/packages/llms/src/services/langfuse-telemetry.ts` (BYOK opt-in, `environment` in direct config, `readEnvTraceAttributes`, merge logic) and `sdk/packages/llms/src/providers/ai-sdk.ts` (defer "nothing to propagate" check). 14 new unit tests (opt-in, relay bypass, environment pass-through, tag/metadata parsing, merge rules). CLI sandbox test: BYOK provider exported spans under `cline-langfuse-direct` scope with environment/tags/metadata.

- **Why**: **Alexi has telemetry** (`src/utils/telemetry.js`, `src/core/costTracker.ts` with cost tracking, observability headers in `src/core/streamingOrchestrator.ts` L228 "Build agent observability headers", `src/core/orchestrator.ts` imports `Telemetry`, `src/core/sessionManager.ts` mentions observability in comments) but no Langfuse integration. SAP AI Core operators running benchmarks or isolated runs (CI workflows, agent fleet `auto-implement.yml` / `agent-autohealing.yml` with matrix of 3 models) cannot label traces per environment/suite/commit/model/workflow. Cline pattern: opt-in BYOK provider tracing via `CLINE_LANGFUSE_ALL_PROVIDERS=1` (direct exporter only, never OTLP relay), pass `LANGFUSE_TRACING_ENVIRONMENT` / `CLINE_LANGFUSE_TAGS` / `CLINE_LANGFUSE_METADATA` as trace attributes, merge env attributes with call-site attributes (tags deduped, call-site metadata wins). **Alexi already has SAP AI Core providers** (`src/providers/` with 16 files, `src/providers/sapOrchestration.ts`, `src/providers/index.ts` with `getProviderForModel`, `src/providers/modelCatalog.ts`) and telemetry infrastructure — need to integrate Langfuse SDK, wrap provider calls with tracing instrumentation, parse env config for tags/metadata/environment, add opt-in for BYOK providers. LOW PRIORITY ~6-8h (requires Langfuse SDK dependency, provider wrapper instrumentation, env parsing, tests, lower priority than subagent UX improvements).

- **Source**: https://github.com/cline/cline/pull/14787 (Cline Langfuse BYOK tracing, merged 2026-10-03, 3 commits), /home/runner/work/alexi/alexi/src/providers/ (SAP AI Core providers, 16 files), /home/runner/work/alexi/alexi/src/utils/telemetry.js (existing telemetry), /home/runner/work/alexi/alexi/src/core/costTracker.ts (cost tracking with observability comments), /home/runner/work/alexi/alexi/src/core/streamingOrchestrator.ts (observability headers L228)

- **Category**: providers (Langfuse tracing instrumentation) + config (env parsing for tags/metadata/environment)

- **Size**: MEDIUM ~6-8h (add `langfuse` SDK dependency to `package.json`, create `src/providers/langfuse-telemetry.ts` following Cline pattern: `resolveAiSdkTelemetry` with BYOK opt-in via `ALEXI_LANGFUSE_ALL_PROVIDERS=1` (check env, return direct exporter config with `LANGFUSE_BASE_URL` / `LANGFUSE_PUBLIC_KEY` / `LANGFUSE_SECRET_KEY`, never OTLP relay for BYOK), `readEnvTraceAttributes` parsing `LANGFUSE_TRACING_ENVIRONMENT` / `ALEXI_LANGFUSE_TAGS` (comma-separated) / `ALEXI_LANGFUSE_METADATA` (JSON object or `key=value,...`), `withLangfuseTraceAttributes` merge logic (tags deduped, call-site metadata wins, env-only attributes propagate), wrap provider calls in `src/providers/sapOrchestration.ts` and `src/providers/index.ts` with Langfuse tracing instrumentation, pass environment/tags/metadata as trace attributes, add unit tests in `src/providers/__tests__/langfuse-telemetry.test.ts` (opt-in, relay bypass for BYOK, environment pass-through, tag/metadata parsing `foo,bar` and `key1=val1,key2=val2`, merge rules: tags deduped, call-site wins, env-only propagates), add integration test with fake Langfuse receiver (check scope `alexi-langfuse-direct`, environment, tags, metadata), verify `npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test` green, document env variables in `docs/PROVIDERS.md` or `contributing.md`)
